items.title: 68091_Joe Turner oral history interview
items.q: Osa is my...My sister's husband name is Osa.

ctx.x: All right, to get things straightened out about from the beginning when you were talkin' about your uncle and your brother-in-law, now, your sister's husband's name is what? You said that, what? First, you called Charles Bryant your uncle but then you said that it...
Osa is my...My sister's husband name is Osa.
Your sister's husband was Osa, and Charles was Osa's brother.
